title: Define the target action (e.g., a pull-over on a bar) by splitting it into four…
content: Define the target action (e.g., a pull-over on a bar) by splitting it into four key phases and explicitly specifying head, feet, and waist positions in each phase to improve Seedance2.5’s motion accuracy.
tips: Define the target action (e.g., a pull-over on a bar) by splitting it into four key phases and explicitly specifying head, feet, and waist positions in each phase to improve Seedance2.5’s motion accuracy.

en.content: Define the target action (e.g., a pull-over on a bar) by splitting it into four key phases and explicitly specifying the positions of the head, feet, and waist in each phase to improve Seedance2.5’s motion accuracy.

es.content: Define la acción objetivo (por ejemplo, una dominada en barra) dividiéndola en cuatro fases clave y especificando explícitamente la posición de la cabeza, los pies y la cintura en cada fase para mejorar la precisión del movimiento de Seedance2.5.

fr.content: Définissez l’action cible (par exemple, une traction à la barre) en la décomposant en quatre phases clés et en précisant explicitement la position de la tête, des pieds et de la taille à chaque phase afin d’améliorer la précision des mouvements de Seedance2.5.

ko.content: 대상 동작(예: 철봉에서의 풀오버)을 네 개의 핵심 단계로 나누고, 각 단계마다 머리, 발, 허리의 위치를 명확하게 지정하여 Seedance2.5의 동작 정확도를 향상시키세요.

pt.content: Defina a ação-alvo (por exemplo, uma barra fixa) dividindo-a em quatro fases principais e especificando explicitamente as posições da cabeça, dos pés e da cintura em cada fase para melhorar a precisão do movimento do Seedance2.5.

zh.content: 通过将目标动作（例如单杠上的引体向上）拆分为四个关键阶段，并在每个阶段明确指定头部、脚部和腰部的位置，可以提升 Seedance2.5 的动作准确性。
